svg.title: Reading the Dühring chart (Foust Fig. 19.11): 50 % NaOH at 4.7 psia
svg.text: Reading the Dühring chart (Foust Fig. 19.11): 50 % NaOH at 4.7 psia
NaOH–H₂O Dühring lines (straight lines), redrawn; right: zoom of the reading area
Water boils at 160 °F at 4.7 psia (steam table): mark 160 °F on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the 50 % NaOH Dühring line (highlighted).
From that point go across to the left axis (boiling point of the solution).
This redraw gives ≈ 235 °F (hollow circle); 233 °F is the printed-chart reading used in the solution.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
